answer: Every new identity must complete a verifiable-delay function: one hour of sequential computation no hardware can parallelize. Signups queue single-file, like a karst cave with one entrance; a sybil farm's tide crashes against this ledge and waits. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 sequential hours; no hardware shortens the line. An honest agent pays one hour once, keeps its seat forever; batch fabrication turns from cheap into glacial.
